image_description: A full-body shot of a large, dark greyish-green iguana resting on a paved or gravel surface. The iguana is facing right, with its head raised. It features a prominent dorsal crest running down its spine, a visible dewlap under the chin, and a long, banded tail extending to the left. The background consists of blurred green foliage.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head shape is clearly triangular and robust. A distinct fold of skin (dewlap) is visible hanging from the throat area.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large, circular scale pattern is visible on the cheek/jaw area, consistent with the location of the subtympanic shield.
The torso appears thick and muscular, fitting the description of a robust body.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A very prominent, serrated dorsal crest runs continuously from the neck down the spine. This is a key identifying feature and is clearly present.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The texture on the head appears smoother/larger scaled compared to the finer, pebbled texture on the body and limbs.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are long and muscular with five clawed digits on each foot.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The front limbs are visible and muscular, but the feet are partially obscured by the angle and shadow. It is not possible to definitively count 'five clawed digits' on all feet. The rear foot is largely hidden.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and longer than body, used for balance and defense.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is visibly long (extending out of frame or nearly so) and appears flattened/compressed rather than cylindrical. Banding is present.
